R setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
```


Read CSV, then plot using ggplot, geom_point for opacity
```{r}
penguin_data <- read.csv("../penglings.csv")


penguinPlot <-  ggplot(penguin_data, aes(
    x = flipper_length_mm,
    y = body_mass_g,
    color = species,
    size = bill_length_mm,
    #> text variable is for tooltips/technical advancement
    text = paste0(
      "Species: ", species,
      "<br>Island: ", island,
      "<br>Bill Length: ", bill_length_mm, " mm",
      "<br>Flipper Length: ", flipper_length_mm, " mm",
      "<br>Body Mass: ", body_mass_g, " g",
      "<br>Sex: ", sex,
      "<br>Year: ", year
    ))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Bill Length (mm)",
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Penguin Data using R/ggplot2",
      x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
      y = "Body Mass (g)",
      color = "Species"
    ) +
    theme_dark()
```

Adding tooltips
```{r}
ggplotly(penguinPlot, tooltip = "text")

```
